properties.description: Stranger Things (released 2016) is a Netflix series created by Matt and Ross Duffer that blends drama, science fiction, horror, and mystery. Starring Millie Bobby Brown, Finn Wolfhard and Winona Ryder among an ensemble cast, it follows a group of children in 1980s Indiana who uncover government experiments and otherworldly threats after a friend goes missing. The series mixes coming-of-age character work and family drama with suspenseful supernatural mysteries, and leans heavily on nostalgic 1980s cinematic and production design to shape its emotional tone of wonder edged by dread.

short_descriptions.value: In 1980s Indiana, a group of kids confronts supernatural forces and secret government experiments while searching for their missing friend.
Im Indiana der 1980er kämpfen eine Gruppe Kinder gegen übernatürliche Kräfte und geheime staatliche Experimente, während sie nach ihrem verschwundenen Freund suchen.
En los años 80 en Indiana, un grupo de niños se enfrenta a fuerzas sobrenaturales y experimentos secretos del gobierno mientras busca a un amigo desaparecido.
Dans l'Indiana des années 1980, un groupe d'enfants affronte des forces surnaturelles et des expériences gouvernementales secrètes en recherchant un ami disparu.
